decision.rationale: TXN-007961 was posted on 2026-09-02 on card CRD-000008 at Larkspur Getaways (MER-000052, a TRAVEL merchant). The dispute was opened on 2026-10-23, 51 days later, so it is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The posted amount is 25841 cents and authorisation AUTH-008164 was approved for the same 25841 cents, so the two amounts agree. The cardholder says the quote was 16797 cents, which would make the difference 9044 cents, but they have no quote and no receipt is attached. An amount the cardholder states is a claim, not a receipt. Under amount-no-receipt, when there is no receipt and the posted amount equals the authorised amount, we ask the merchant for the receipt or order details.

proposed_actions.note: Please provide the receipt or order details for the transaction of 258.41 EUR on 2026-09-01, showing the amount the cardholder agreed to pay.
